input: What are the contact details of the customer who placed the order with the highest total value?
output: SELECT TOP 1 c.CompanyName, c.ContactName, c.ContactTitle, c.Phone, c.Fax FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY c.CompanyName, c.ContactName, c.ContactTitle, c.Phone, c.Fax ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC

input: Which category has the highest average unit price?
output: SELECT TOP 1 CategoryID, AVG(UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice FROM Products GROUP BY CategoryID ORDER BY AvgUnitPrice DESC

input: How many orders have been placed in total?
output: SELECT COUNT(OrderID) AS TotalOrders FROM Orders

input: Which countries have the highest average freight cost per order?
output: SELECT o.ShipCountry, AVG(o.Freight) AS AvgFreightCost FROM Orders o GROUP BY o.ShipCountry HAVING AVG(o.Freight) > 50 ORDER BY AvgFreightCost DESC

input: List the contact details for customers who have a contact title of 'Owner'.
output: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.ContactName, c.ContactTitle, c.Address, c.City, c.Region, c.PostalCode, c.Country, c.Phone, c.Fax FROM Customers c WHERE c.ContactTitle = 'Owner';

input: How many units of each product are currently in stock in each region?
output: SELECT p.ProductID, p.ProductName, p.UnitsInStock, o.ShipRegion FROM Products p JOIN OrderDetails od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID JOIN Orders o ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID

input: Which product categories have the highest total revenue and how many units have been sold in each category?
output: SELECT p.CategoryID, c.CategoryName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue, SUM(od.Quantity) AS TotalUnitsSold FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID JOIN OrderDetails od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY p.CategoryID, c.CategoryName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC

input: How many products are currently in stock?
output: SELECT SUM(UnitsInStock) AS TotalProductsInStock FROM Products

input: How many products have been discontinued?
output: SELECT COUNT(*) AS DiscontinuedProductsCount FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = 1

input: How many units of each product have been ordered and what is the total revenue for each product?
output: SELECT od.ProductID, p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS TotalUnitsOrdered, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM OrderDetails od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY od.ProductID, p.ProductName

input: What is the average number of days taken to ship an order?
output: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(day, OrderDate, ShippedDate)) AS AvgShippingDays FROM Orders WHERE ShippedDate IS NOT NULL

input: Which employees have processed the most orders?
output: SELECT TOP 5 o.EmployeeID, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders o GROUP BY o.EmployeeID ORDER BY OrderCount DESC;

input: Which customers have placed orders for products with the highest total price?
output: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity) AS TotalPrice FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName ORDER BY TotalPrice DESC

input: How many orders have not been shipped yet?
output: SELECT COUNT(*) AS UnshippedOrdersCount FROM Orders WHERE ShippedDate IS NULL

input: How many customers do we have in each country?

input: For each product, what is the total revenue and average discount applied in the orders?
output: SELECT od.ProductID, p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue, AVG(od.Discount) AS AvgDiscount FROM OrderDetails od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY od.ProductID, p.ProductName

input: Which products have the lowest units in stock?
output: SELECT TOP 5 ProductID, ProductName, UnitsInStock FROM Products ORDER BY UnitsInStock ASC

input: Which products have the highest revenue per unit sold?
output: SELECT p.ProductID, p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity) / SUM(od.Quantity) AS RevenuePerUnit FROM Products p JOIN OrderDetails od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.ProductName ORDER BY RevenuePerUnit DESC
